name: tabletop-games
description: Browser-based tabletop simulator with pluggable games

scripts.build: npm run build -w @tabletop-games/shared && npm run build -w @tabletop-games/client && npm run build -w @tabletop-games/server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,server,client -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @tabletop-games/shared" "npm run dev -w @tabletop-games/server" "npm run dev -w @tabletop-games/client"
